lessons.title: Find Your Way
lessons.summary: Practice the icons that help you move through apps and websites without feeling lost.
lessons.completion_message: You can now recognize the common controls used to move, search, refresh, and close.

steps.heading: Return to a familiar starting point
steps.instruction: The Home icon takes you to the main screen of an app or website.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Home when you want the main screen without closing the app.

steps.heading: Return to the previous screen
steps.instruction: The Back icon returns to the screen or page you just left.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Back after opening the wrong page.

steps.heading: Move to the next page again
steps.instruction: The Forward icon moves ahead after you have used Back.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Forward to revisit the page that came after the current one.

steps.heading: Open the main choices
steps.instruction: The Menu icon reveals sections and actions that are not always visible.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Menu to look for Profile, Help, Settings, or Sign Out.

steps.heading: Find information
steps.instruction: The Search icon helps locate people, files, settings, messages, or topics.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Search when you know a word but not where the item is stored.

steps.heading: Reveal additional choices
steps.instruction: The More icon opens actions that do not fit on the current screen.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose More to look for actions such as Print, Share, Move, or Delete.

steps.heading: Load current information again
steps.instruction: The Refresh icon reloads a page or updates the information shown.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Refresh when a page looks outdated or did not finish loading.

steps.heading: Dismiss a window or message
steps.instruction: The Close icon dismisses a screen, window, menu, or message.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Close when you are finished with a pop-up.

lessons.title: Work With Files
lessons.summary: Follow the common actions used to create, organize, save, transfer, and remove files.
lessons.completion_message: You can now recognize the main icons used to create, store, transfer, share, and remove files.

steps.heading: Create something new
steps.instruction: The Add icon begins a new item such as a file, contact, event, or tab.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Add to begin creating a new item.

steps.heading: Change an existing item
steps.instruction: The Edit icon lets you revise information that already exists.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Edit before changing a note, contact, photograph, or document.

steps.heading: Keep your changes
steps.instruction: The Save icon stores the current version of your work.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Save after making changes you want to keep.

steps.heading: Open a container for files
steps.instruction: The Folder icon contains files and may also contain other folders.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Folder to browse organized documents or photographs.

steps.heading: Recognize a document
steps.instruction: The Document icon represents a file containing text or other information.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Document when you want to open or review a written file.

steps.heading: Bring a file onto your device
steps.instruction: The Download icon saves a file from a website or service onto your device.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Download to keep a trusted file on your device.

steps.heading: Send a file from your device
steps.instruction: The Upload icon sends a local file into an app, website, or cloud service.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Upload when a trusted website asks you to provide a file.

steps.heading: Include a file with a message
steps.instruction: The Attach icon adds a document or photograph to a message or form.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Attach to include a file with an email.

steps.heading: Send a copy or link
steps.instruction: The Share icon sends an item or link to another person or app.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Share after confirming the item and recipient.

steps.heading: Create a paper copy
steps.instruction: The Print icon sends a document or picture to a selected printer.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Print after checking the printer, pages, and number of copies.

steps.heading: Remove an item
steps.instruction: The Delete icon removes the selected item and may be difficult to undo.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Delete only after confirming that the correct item is selected.

lessons.title: Communicate and Use Media
lessons.summary: Recognize the controls used for calls, messages, photographs, sound, and playback.
lessons.completion_message: You can now identify the common icons used for communication, recording, sound, and media playback.

steps.heading: Find a saved person
steps.instruction: The Contacts icon opens saved names, numbers, and contact details.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Contacts before calling or messaging a saved person.

steps.heading: Review a date or appointment
steps.instruction: The Calendar icon shows dates, appointments, reminders, and scheduled events.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Calendar to check an appointment or create an event.

steps.heading: Start a call
steps.instruction: The Phone icon starts or represents a telephone or internet call.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Phone to call a confirmed contact.

steps.heading: Open a conversation
steps.instruction: The Message icon opens text messages, chat, or another conversation.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Message to read or write a text response.

steps.heading: Deliver the message
steps.instruction: The Send icon delivers a message, email, form, or file.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Send only after reviewing the recipient and attachments.

steps.heading: Take or add a picture
steps.instruction: The Camera icon opens the camera or adds a photograph or video.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Camera for a picture, video call, or document scan.

steps.heading: Use your voice
steps.instruction: The Microphone icon begins voice input, recording, or speech-to-text.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Microphone to dictate, record, or speak a search.

steps.heading: Control sound level
steps.instruction: The Volume icon makes sound louder, quieter, or muted.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Volume before playing media when you need to check the sound level.

steps.heading: Start media
steps.instruction: The Play icon starts a video, recording, song, or animation.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Play when you are ready to watch or listen.

steps.heading: Temporarily hold your place
steps.instruction: The Pause icon temporarily stops media while keeping your place.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Pause when you plan to continue the same media shortly.

steps.heading: End playback or recording
steps.instruction: The Stop icon ends playback, recording, or another active process.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Stop when you are finished with playback or recording.

lessons.title: Stay Safe and Connected
lessons.summary: Learn the icons that manage device connections, permissions, notices, and safer decisions.
lessons.completion_message: You can now recognize common connection, permission, information, and safety icons.

steps.heading: Control how the device works
steps.instruction: The Settings icon opens controls for privacy, sound, display, notifications, and accounts.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Settings when you need to change one device or app option.

steps.heading: Review alerts calmly
steps.instruction: The Notifications icon shows alerts, reminders, and recent activity.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Notifications to review an alert before deciding whether it needs action.

steps.heading: Manage wireless internet
steps.instruction: The Wi-Fi icon shows or manages a wireless internet connection.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Wi-Fi to check or change the current network connection.

steps.heading: Connect a nearby device
steps.instruction: The Bluetooth icon pairs trusted nearby headphones, keyboards, cars, and other devices.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Bluetooth after confirming the nearby device name.

steps.heading: Notice protected access
steps.instruction: The Lock icon indicates security, privacy, or an encrypted connection.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose the Lock for security information, while remembering it does not prove a website is honest.

steps.heading: Reveal or preview content
steps.instruction: The View icon shows hidden content or opens a preview.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose View to check hidden text, then hide sensitive information again.

steps.heading: Pause before continuing
steps.instruction: The Warning icon signals that something needs attention before you act.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Warning as your cue to stop, read, and verify.

steps.heading: Find trusted guidance
steps.instruction: The Help icon opens instructions, support information, or common answers.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Help inside the official app or website when you need guidance.

steps.heading: Read additional details
steps.instruction: The Information icon explains an item, setting, or situation.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Information to learn more before making a decision.

steps.heading: Manage location use
steps.instruction: The Location icon shows a place or indicates that an app may use your location.
steps.practice_prompt: Choose Location for maps or directions and allow access only when needed.
